techniques.name: Phishing: Spearphishing Link
techniques.procedure: Phishing URLs distributed via email and social media, impersonating major platforms including streaming services, social networks, and cryptocurrency wallets.

techniques.name: Link Target
techniques.procedure: Phishing infrastructure hosted on legitimate platforms (Vercel, GitHub Pages, Webflow, Netlify, Cloudflare Workers, IPFS) to evade domain reputation blocklists.

techniques.name: Domains
techniques.procedure: Typosquatting domains mimicking Meta, Microsoft, and cryptocurrency exchanges used as phishing landing pages.

techniques.name: Application Layer Protocol: Web Protocols
techniques.procedure: Active Emotet C2 IP addresses identified via Feodo Tracker, communicating over HTTP/HTTPS.
